comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) map by key later; V1 shows captions only. Specific-key entries (e.g. 'landmark.enter.Devon House') are checked before the generic fallback ('landmark.enter') — add per-landmark flavour lines here with no TypeScript changes needed.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
landmark.enter.Norman Manley Internation: Norman Manley Airport — named after a true National Hero. Leh wi drive!
Left di airport — di real Jamaica start right now, brethren!
landmark.enter.Gun Boat Beach: Gun Boat Beach — harbour water calm calm on di left, open sea rough on di right. Pure Palisadoes vibes!
Best beach on di Palisadoes strip — coconut tree line up and everything!
landmark.enter.Port Royal: Port Royal sign deh — wickedest city on earth, sank in di earthquake of 1692. Duppy town!
Port Royal — pirate capital, earthquake victim, pure Jamaican history right deh so!
landmark.enter.Harbour View Roundabout: Harbour View roundabout — Kingston Harbour open up to di left. Welcome to di city, driver!
Leavin' di Palisadoes — di capital spread out before yuh. Drive wid respect!
landmark.enter.National Stadium: National Stadium! Every Olympic medal, every World Championship — Jamaica prove herself right deh so!
Di stadium where legends born — from Herb McKenley to Usain Bolt, dis ground know greatness!
landmark.enter.Excelsior High School: Excelsior High — right deh cross from di National Stadium. Champions on both sides a di road!
Big up Excelsior! Track star, academic star — Excelsior nuh play around!
landmark.enter.National Heroes Park: National Heroes Park — Marcus Garvey, Norman Manley, Bustamante all rest deh so. Give respect!
Di resting place of Jamaica's greatest sons and daughters. Drive slow, show reverence!
landmark.enter.Jamaica College: Jamaica College — di Old Boys keep di tradition alive! Old Hope Road, serious academics!
JC right deh — Jamaica College, where excellence is di standard and di Old Boys nuh forget!
landmark.enter.Bob Marley Museum: Fifty-Six Hope Road — di Tuff Gong lived right here! One Love from di legend himself!
Bob Marley Museum! Di whole world come a Jamaica to touch dis ground. Pure spirit right deh so!
Tuff Gong home — reggae was born right here pon Hope Road. Feel di vibration!
landmark.enter.Devon House: Devon House! George Stiebel — Jamaica's first Black millionaire — build dis mansion in 1881. And di ice cream? Best inna di world!
Devon House ice cream — yuh MUST stop next time, driver. Di best scoop on di island, no argument!
See Devon House deh — history and ice cream in di same place. Jamaica always do it different!
landmark.enter.Tracks & Records: Tracks and Records! Usain Bolt own restaurant — world's fastest man jerk chicken? Dat must be fast too!
Bolt's place — Constant Spring Road. Di man run nine-five-eight AND him cook? Jamaica nuh stop!
landmark.enter.Emancipation Park: Emancipation Park — Redemption Song sculpture stand tall. From slavery to freedom, Jamaica remember!
New Kingston green heart — di Redemption Song right deh. Freedom reach, brethren!
landmark.enter.Half Way Tree Clock Tower: Half Way Tree clock! 1813 and still keeping time — every Kingstonian know dis corner by heart!
Half Way Tree! Di heartbeat of Kingston — every bus, every taxi, every face pass through here!
Di clock tower! Half Way Tree been di crossroads of dis city for two hundred years. Respect to di place!
landmark.enter.St. Andrew High School: St. Andrew High! Top girls school, Half Way Tree — STATHS gyal dem run tings!
St. Andrew High School — excellence in di heart of Half Way Tree. Big up di institution!
landmark.enter.Holy Childhood High Schoo: Holy Childhood High — Catholic education, Half Way Tree. Deep roots in Jamaican learning!
Big up Holy Childhood! Half Way Tree school wid generations of proud graduates!
landmark.enter.KFC Half Way Tree: KFC Half Way Tree! Highest-grossing KFC inna di whole world — Jamaica love di colonel SERIOUS!
Di KFC right deh — highest grossing inna di world dem say. Jamaican people nuh play when it come to chicken!
landmark.enter.Tastee Patties: Tastee Patties! Di original Jamaican patty since 1966 — nuttn nuh beat a fresh Tastee!
Tastee! Every Jamaican grow up on dis — beef patty inna coco bread, pure memories right deh so!
landmark.enter.Juici Patties: Juici Patties right deh! Di great patty rivalry — Tastee or Juici? Every Jamaican have di opinion!
Juici Patties! You a Tastee person or Juici person? Di debate never done in Jamaica!
landmark.enter.Burger King: Burger King New Kingston — Jamaicans choose di Whopper and dem own jerk chicken in di same breath!
BK right deh — Half Way Tree strip. Jamaican fast food culture is its own thing entirely!
landmark.enter.Calabar High School: CALABAR! Red Hills Road — di Great House, di best boys school inna Jamaica! Big up di Baptist foundation!
Calabar High — Red Hills Road. From di Great House to di track, Calabar man dem nuh easy!
Cala-BAR! Di pride of Red Hills Road — Baptist-founded, champion-producing, nuh stop, nuh stop!
landmark.enter.Hydel High School: Hydel High! Leaving Kingston heading west — Hydel athletes punch above dem weight every season!
Big up Hydel! Spanish Town Road corridor — small school, big heart, bigger dreams!
landmark.enter.Flat Bridge: Flat Bridge! One lane, no railings, river rushing below — most exciting bridge inna Jamaica!
Flat Bridge inna di gorge — Rio Cobre right below yuh. No railings, full trust. Pure Jamaica!
Dis is Flat Bridge — one car at a time, driver. Di river nuh care who inna a hurry!
landmark.enter.Faith's Pen: FAITH'S PEN! Di legendary stop — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival right deh! Pull over, driver!
Faith's Pen — if yuh nuh stop and eat here, yuh doing di journey wrong. Slow down, smell di jerk!
Jerk chicken a-call yuh name! Faith's Pen cookshops line up — dis is di most delicious stretch a road inna Jamaica!
landmark.enter.Fern Gully: FERN GULLY! Di most famous road inna Jamaica — green canopy above, cool air, pure magic!
Fern Gully! Bamboo and fern arch overhead — slow down and tek in di beauty, brethren. Nuh rush dis!
Three kilometre of pure canopy — Fern Gully is di most photographed road on di island. Eyes wide open!
landmark.enter.Ocho Rios Bay: Ocho Rios! Di coast open up — blue Caribbean water straight ahead. Yuh reach, driver!
Ochi Bay right deh! Sea breeze, sunshine, resort town — yuh drive di whole way and deserve dis view!
landmark.enter.Dunn's River Falls: DUNN'S RIVER FALLS! Journey done, brethren — di waterfall a-call yuh name!
Dunn's River Falls — end of di road, beginning of di bath. Jamaica bless yuh, driver! Give thanks!
Yuh reach Dunn's River! Climb di falls, feel di water, celebrate — yuh drove di whole Airport-to-Ochi run!
